title: A newer accepted batch must cancel undelivered bubbles of older epochs (prod cancels; we deliver)
description: respond #44 (epoch 2, three bubbles due 19:56:42/56:50/56:58) was followed 2 s later by submit #45 (epoch 3). Production emitted typing=false at 19:56:39.475 and never delivered any of #44's bubbles; after respond #46 it delivered only the new turn. We delivered all of #44's bubbles interleaved with #46's (local frames 19:56:40-56:57; paired thread d36fb865/86134b8a: 15 vs 10 delivered messages). Implement: when a batch is accepted and the epoch advances, cancel the thread's pending schedules from older epochs (mark them, do not deliver), emit typing=false, and keep the existing stale-epoch respond behaviour (superseded=true, no charge). Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay epoch-cancel check PASS; scheduler unit test for cancel-on-advance; delivered message count on the replayed thread equals production's; realtime suite 83/0/0.

title: Sentence-aware split/merge: 2-bubble short drafts, split long paragraphs, merge fragments (target 6-37 words)
description: engine/naturalizer.py splits only on blank lines. Production: a single-paragraph draft with >=2 sentences whose tail is a question/offer becomes 2 bubbles (#51 12w -> [9,18], #53, #57); paragraphs over ~35 words split at a sentence boundary (#42 45w paragraph -> 2 bubbles; 3 -> 4 total); fragments under ~5 words merge into a neighbour (#38 2-word bubble merged; 5 -> 4); observed prod bubble lengths are 6-37 words. Implement sentence-boundary splitting with that target range, merge-not-truncate, max 5 bubbles. Depends on D1 (normalize first) and D2. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay bubble-count agreement >= 13/16 (baseline 10/16) and a smaller words-per-bubble distribution distance than baseline; realtime pacing floor/cap and merge assertions green.

title: Attachment sentinel lines (MEDIA:/path) must not become bubbles
description: On #46 the draft ended with the Hermes attachment line 'MEDIA:/Users/lou/.hermes/SOUL.md'; we emitted it verbatim as bubble 2 (delivered at 19:56:53 on the local socket) while production dropped the line and kept only prose. Treat lines matching ^MEDIA: (and bare absolute file paths on their own line) as non-text attachments: never emit as a bubble; carry them in metadata or drop, documented either way. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay of #46 yields bubbles without the MEDIA line; unit test covers leading/trailing/only-sentinel drafts; sentinel leak count 0.

title: Normalize markdown before splitting: production bubbles never carry backticks, bullets, or bold
description: Ours passes draft markdown straight into bubbles: code spans and bullet lists in #19 and #21, backticked paths in #32/#38/#46, bold in #44. Production's bubbles on the same drafts are plain prose (lists become sentences, code spans become words). Add a normalization stage ahead of the split: code spans -> plain, bullet/numbered lists -> one sentence per item, bold/italics -> plain, whitespace collapsed; no fact or token dropped (spec/05: content never truncated). Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay markdown-residue rate 0 across the corpus; realtime six-paragraph merge assertion still passes (all seed tokens survive verbatim).

title: recalled_context is empty on every decide: submit_messages never ingests the batch into the thread's bank
description: routes/turn_taking.py _recalled_context() calls memory_engine.recall() but nothing ingests accepted thread messages into thread.memory_bank_id, so for a bank that was never fed through /social-memory/ingest the recall is '' forever (0/19 non-empty; production 17/19, e.g. #15 "L uses 'cuh' as a primary form of address", #20 'L is ... frustrated ...'). Fix: after a batch is accepted (epoch advanced), ingest the speaker-attributed messages into the bank (idempotent per thread message), then recall for the last sender. Preserve the realtime suite's memory assertions: bank switching/preservation on reopen, empty scope is exact '', no duplicate replay. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay: recalled_context non-empty on >= 15/19 decides after the first turn of each thread and names the sender; realtime memory section green (bank switch/preserve, empty scope exact '', ordering, no duplicate replay).

title: Keep Silent for bare address tokens, closers, and dismissals (prod silent 6/10 on <=3-word messages; ours 1/10)
description: Production stays silent on low-content single-sender messages that carry no ask: bare address tokens ('cuh' #14 #15), sign-offs/closers ('ayt den' #54, 'drop it out' #36), dismissals with no question ('dumbass' #49, 'no one cares dawg' #52). Our _ACK_RE only covers ok/thanks/lol-style acknowledgments. Extend the Keep Silent strategy with these classes (word-count bounded, no question mark, no mention of the agent, no pending ask), keeping the LoSoNA multi-word acknowledgment handling and the realtime suite's 'ok thanks' case. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay decision agreement >= 17/19 on the current corpus with the six cited pairs -> stay_silent and direct asks (e.g. #3 'Sam, are you around? need the deploy checklist') -> speak; realtime suite green.

title: Router can only stay silent when a name was parsed from the system prompt
description: engine/router.py decide(): stay_silent is returned only when `names` (parsed from 'You are X' / 'addresses X' patterns) is non-empty. Hermes SOUL prompts match neither pattern, so names=[] and the router answers speak for every message. All six disagreements in the corpus (#14, #15, #36, #49, #52, #54) are ours=speak / theirs=stay_silent with tags []. Fix: make Keep Silent reachable without a parsed name; take the agent identity from agent_name persisted on the thread (respond carries it) and from the system prompt, and only use names for the Directly Mentioned override. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Replay: decide on #14 and #15 ('cuh') returns stay_silent; realtime suite stays 83/0/0 (stay_silent induction and direct-address speak cases intact).

title: Golden replay harness: score fresh local responses against recorded production responses
description: tools/parity/replay.py boots the service on a scratch DB (as service/tests do), replays each recorded thread from tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite in seq order — open_thread with the same integrations, submit_messages batches with system_prompt, respond with draft/pacing/agent_name/metadata, social-learning extract — remapping ids, and compares the fresh local response to the recorded prod response. Scores: decision agreement + confusion matrix; recalled_context non-empty rate and sender mention; bubble-count agreement; words-per-bubble distribution distance; markdown residue rate (backticks, bullet markers, bold); attachment-sentinel leak count; pacing-offset equality for equal bubble sets; epoch-cancel invariant (submit while schedules pending -> older schedules cancelled). Writes tools/parity/golden-score.json and one scalar parity_divergence (weighted, lower is better). Excludes pre-proxy threads (prod 404 on seq 5-11) and non-200 pairs. No production calls, no credits. Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: `tools/parity/replay.py --db tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite` runs offline in under 60 s, is deterministic across two runs, writes golden-score.json, and prints today's baseline: router 13/19, recall 0/19, bubble-count 10/16, markdown residue > 0, sentinel leaks 1 (#46), epoch-cancel FAIL, pacing PASS on equal bubble sets (#19).

title: Golden parity (phase 9): close recreation↔production gaps measured by the shadow dataset
description: RC1 is green on both live suites, yet the shadow dataset (tools/shadow: live Hermes traffic on 2026-08-21 served by the recreation and mirrored to production; 57 pairs, 139 WS frames) shows the recreation diverging from production on exactly the behaviours the suites do not pin: router silence on low-content messages (ours silent 1/10 vs theirs 6/10 on <=3-word messages; 6/19 decisions disagree, all ours=speak/theirs=stay_silent), memory recall on decide (recalled_context non-empty 0/19 vs 17/19), naturalizer splitting and formatting (bubble-count agreement 10/16; markdown passes through; an attachment sentinel became a bubble), epoch supersession (production cancels undelivered bubbles when a newer batch arrives; we deliver them), and social-learning profile richness (no lexicon/norms). Plan: build an offline replay harness that scores fresh local responses against the recorded production responses (no credits), then land engine fixes measured by that harness, then close a milestone with numeric targets. Spec stance honoured: prose is semantic, not byte-equal (hum-tw9); model policy stays configuration (ADRs hum-tisv, hum-vdio). Evidence: tools/shadow/golden/shadow.sqlite (exchange seq numbers below); digest: tools/shadow/gaps.py.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone 'Golden parity v1' closed with its numeric targets met on the replay harness, both live suites green, and every child bead closed with replay evidence.
